themes_detail.label: Street Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints spiked to 60 THIS WEEK, nearly 4x the 8-week average of 15.2 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.42), suggesting a sudden, acute disturbance pattern affecting outdoor public spaces across Midwood.
evidence: 60 noise complaints (street/sidewalk) THIS WEEK vs. 15.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
294% increase from baseline (z-score: 4.42, high severity flagged)
Spike is acute and current—not sustained from weeks prior
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden surge in outdoor noise this week? (construction, events, street activity)
Interview residents on Ocean Parkway and major intersections about quality-of-life impact

themes_detail.label: Construction & Plumbing Crisis
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints jumped to 52 THIS WEEK—4x the 8-week average of 12.8 (z-score: 7.39)—indicating either a coordinated construction boom or widespread infrastructure failure across the district.
evidence: 52 construction/plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 12.8 weekly baseline
318 total DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (239 alteration filings alone) suggest active construction environment
reporting_angles: Map the 52 complaints: Are they clustered around specific rezoning projects (e.g., 1455 Coney Island Ave, 2586 Nostrand Ave)?
Interview DOB and contractors about permit density and whether simultaneous projects are straining district infrastructure

themes_detail.label: Encampment Spike Begins
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints surged to 5 THIS WEEK against a baseline of 0.4 weekly average (1233% increase, z-score: 4.66), marking the emergence of a homelessness/street occupancy issue not previously detected in the district.
evidence: 5 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
1233% spike (z-score: 4.66, high severity) indicates brand-new or rapidly accelerating issue
This is the first major emergence of this category in recent baseline data
reporting_angles: Where are the 5 encampments located? (Specific blocks on Ocean Parkway, transit hubs, parks?)
Interview residents and local businesses about impact; contact DHS and NYPD about service response

themes_detail.label: Residential Disposal Complaints Persist
themes_detail.summary: Residential disposal complaints remained elevated at 24 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO (300% above the 6-complaint weekly baseline, z-score: 5.31)—a high-severity spike suggesting garbage management or illegal dumping issues have not resolved.
evidence: 24 residential disposal complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 6.0 weekly average
Related: Dumpster complaints up 2300% (3 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 avg) and sanitation worker complaints up 300% last week
reporting_angles: Is illegal dumping concentrated in specific neighborhoods (Midwood vs. Ocean Parkway)?
Check if Sanitation Department has adjusted collection routes or if private carters are failing residents

themes_detail.label: Building Alteration Surge
themes_detail.summary: 239 alteration permits filed in the last 90 days constitute 75% of all DOB filings (318 total), paired with active ULURP rezonings (1455 Coney Island Ave, 2586 Nostrand Ave), suggesting large-scale residential or commercial renovation ahead of potential upzoning.
evidence: 239 alteration filings (75% of 318 total DOB filings in 90 days)
5 active land-use proposals in pipeline, including 2 rezonings at advanced stages
Convergence of alteration permits + rezoning applications suggests developer anticipation
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents: Are alteration permits displacing tenants or changing neighborhood character?
Map the 239 alteration permits against the 5 rezoning proposals—is there a geographic or speculative pattern?
